headline: Anupam Rasayan's open offer for Bliss GVS Pharma updated with PAC addendum
sum: Anupam Rasayan Limited filed an addendum to its public announcement and detailed public statement for the open offer of Bliss GVS Pharma Limited, adding a public announcement committee (PAC) disclosure. The addendum was submitted to NSE as a regulatory update to the ongoing open offer process.
detail: Anupam Rasayan Limited, the acquirer, submitted an addendum to both the Public Announcement and the Detailed Public Statement for its open offer to acquire Bliss GVS Pharma Limited. The addendum specifically addresses the addition of a Public Announcement Committee (PAC), a mandatory governance structure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations. The filing was notified to the NSE on 19 July 2026. The parties and offer valuation remain undisclosed in the available public record.
